integrity: Exact normalizations, root orbits and deficit identity are derived algebraically. Computations corroborate only the specified finite fields; no claims of independent validation or exhaustive literature priority.
scientific_limitations: The nonplanar phase-orbit equations are necessary and sufficient but are not parametrically enumerated, although their quotient group is proven finite. Generality rests on the analytic argument rather than the nine finite cases. An older equivalent theorem in additive-energy or coding-theoretic terminology remains possible.
title: Odd-characteristic Gold graphs: sharp fourth moments, phase constraints and exact deficits
